Talks·Digestive Disease Week (DDW) 2026

NLP-based classification of bowel preparation quality in colonoscopy reports

May 4, 2026 · Chicago, IL, United States

Summary

Poster presentation (Mo2176) of an NLP pipeline that classifies bowel-preparation quality from free-text colonoscopy reports (11,374 reports; TF-IDF + logistic regression; ~92% cross-validated accuracy). Selected for the AGA Innovation Themed Walking Tour.
